summary.headline: Moon–Saturn in Taurus and Gemini
summary.text: Astrological interpretations of the Moon’s conjunction with Saturn after separation in Taurus and Gemini, including trines, sextiles, squares, and oppositions. The predictions concern cold, hail, dust, prices, agriculture, rulers, cities, markets, earthquakes, and conditions in Gorgan and the foothills of Iran; the Cancer interpretation begins at the end.
